args.reason: The dry-run part serves the inspection goal, but the DoD also requires a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, a --explain historical timeline, a --since filter and a --format toggle. The PRD states that historical storage and query features are outside its scope, so two of the three DoD items deliver capability beyond the declared goals. Phase 1 called this a natural extension of inspection; the PRD explicitly excludes it. This is gold-plating.
